title: The Skywalker twins
description: George Lucas initially intended to call this film Return of the Jedi, but then changed the title to Revenge of the Jedi when Lawrence Kasdan opined that "Return" sounded soft. Only a few weeks before the film's release did Lucas switch the moniker back to Return. He explained rather logically that a noble Jedi wouldn't seek revenge. Coincidentally, Paramount Pictures was preparing Star Trek: The Vengeance of Khan at the very same time, and many in the industry were bothered by this similarity of sci-fi movie titles. Ultimately, Trek turned to Wrath, the Jedi did indeed "return," and "revenge" was cannily called upon decades later (Episode Ill), in service of the more-appropriate Sith.
